name: cas
title: Compare-and-swap
summary: Every worker increments one counter by compare-and-swap, counting each retry, or increments a plain counter under a lock built from the same instruction.

controls.name: operation
controls.label: Operation
controls.hint: cas: a compare-and-swap loop on the counter. lock: a plain increment inside a lock built from compare-and-swap.

results.name: observed
results.label: Observed
results.what: the counter after the last worker finished

results.name: retries
results.label: Retries
results.what: compare-and-swaps that failed and went round again, all workers

results.name: most
results.label: Most by one worker
results.what: the retries of the worker that retried most

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model of each worker's load, add and compare-and-swap, with the retry when the compare fails
